stage0044b_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「So that blue star is Earth...」

stage0044b_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$グーラ$$
「True enough.
　I'll grant you that.」

stage0044b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$グーラ$$ and $$正太郎$$'s group got real close
　on the way to Earth.」

stage0044b_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Even from different planets, they're close in age.
　No wonder they hit it off.」

stage0044b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$マッキー$$
「But you know, $$グーラ$$
　has an elegance $$正太郎$$ and $$ワッ太$$ lack.」

stage0044b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$さやか$$
「Heh... seems $$マッキー$$ has her eye on $$グーラ$$.」

stage0044b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Maybe $$グーラ$$ is
　a prince from some planet, don't you think?」

stage0044b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Whoa, hold on!
　Dumping $$正太郎$$ for $$グーラ$$?」

stage0044b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Oh, come on, $$甲児$$!
　It's not like that with me and $$正太郎$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$...
　$$マッキー$$'s saying something.」

stage0044b_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Just ignore them.
　...$$グーラ$$, once we land,
　I'll show you all kinds of places.」

stage0044b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「On the way here,
　I learned about Earth from you and the records.」

stage0044b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$グーラ$$
「The more I learn, the more worthless it seems.」

stage0044b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you talking about!?
　Don't act like you know Earth from that!」

stage0044b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$タケル$$
「What's up, $$ワッ太$$?
　A fight?」

stage0044b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Listen to this, $$タケル$$!
　$$グーラ$$ says Earth's a worthless planet!」

stage0044b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop it, $$ワッ太$$.
　You too, $$グーラ$$.」

stage0044b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$... I guess we haven't
　done a good job showing you Earth.」

stage0044b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But I want you to understand,
　that our planet, Earth, is a wonderful place.」

stage0044b_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's right, $$グーラ$$.
　Too soon to judge from so little.」

stage0044b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$タケル$$
「Land on Earth, and I bet things
　that'll surprise you are waiting.」

stage0044b_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$グーラ$$
「If only there were time for that...」

stage0044b_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$田中司令$$
「This isn't much of a welcome-back party.」

stage0044b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$n
「UG... they're striking here, of all places?」

stage0044b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$葵$$
「Not sure why,
　but that unmanned bat looks to be
　targeting $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.」

stage0044b_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Could it be... them!?
　Are they after $$グーラ$$!?」

stage0044b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$甲児$$
「Given the situation, what else could it be!」

stage0044b_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right, $$グーラ$$.
　$c won't lose to the likes of them.」

stage0044b_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Of course.
　We're friends, aren't we.」

stage0044b_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Whoever they are,
　if they come at us, we'll fight back!
　Let's go, everyone!」

stage0044b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$タケル$$
（What is this...
　This bad feeling keeps swelling inside me...）

stage0044b_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「How do you like that!
　Did you see, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$マッキー$$
「I thought he was right there a second ago...」

stage0044b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it...!
　Tenacious for a lousy bat!」

stage0044b_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait for us, $$グーラ$$!
　We'll wipe out those guys in no time!」

stage0044b_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$マッキー$$
「I thought he was right there a second ago...」

stage0044b_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Watch out!
　The ones who took out the bat are coming!」

stage0044b_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$桂$$
「Dealing with it is our job!
　Let's go without complaining!」

stage0044b_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Showing up at a time like this...
　does the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ want $$グーラ$$ too?」

stage0044b_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$マッキー$$
「$$正太郎$$!
　Papa and I will look for $$グーラ$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Count on it, $$マッキー$$!
　We'll fight off the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army!」

stage0044b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, commence attack...!
　Destroy the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s forces!」

stage0044b_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Hey, who's that!
　Trying to open the hatch!」

stage0044b_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「No good...!
　We won't seal it in time!」

stage0044b_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Is that $$グーラ$$ in there!?」

stage0044b_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's reckless, $$グーラ$$!
　Fighting in a $$シャトル|lc$$ like that!」

stage0044b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$タケル$$
「No good!
　He's going to be hit!!」

stage0044b_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I am Demon General $$ダンカン$$.
　I've come to escort you, Prince $$グーラ$$」

stage0044b_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Ah... it seems your long slumber
　has cost you some of your memories」

stage0044b_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「But I understand.
　The fact that you've come for me means...」

stage0044b_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
???
「$$グーラ$$...
　The time has finally come.」

stage0044b_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That monster showed up out of nowhere!」

stage0044b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$マオ$$
「That overprotective idiot of a father
　must've warped space to send it in!」

stage0044b_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Father, I will fight as well.」

stage0044b_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Father...!
　Leave the rest to me!」

stage0044b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$.
　Don't disappoint me」

stage0044b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$グーラ$$
「In the name of $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...」

stage0044b_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$! Are you really going to fight!?」

stage0044b_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$... and you, so-called $c...!
　You, whom Father deems a threat,
　will face me, $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You stubborn fool!
　$$正太郎$$'s calling you
　his friend!」

stage0044b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...
　If you're an ally of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　who's after Earth, I'll fight you!」

stage0044b_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We have a duty to protect Earth!」

stage0044b_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Come at me, $$正太郎$$!
　As one last mercy... I'll face you myself!」

stage0044b_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　We're the ones who'll stop $$グーラ$$!!」

stage0044b_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$タケル$$
（$$正太郎$$...!
　Are you sure about this!）

stage0044b_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Confirmed, all enemies destroyed.
　For now, no reinforcements in sight.」

stage0044b_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「It seems that $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　has the power to warp dimensions.」

stage0044b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$タケル$$
「The son of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　$$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...」

stage0044b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$正太郎$$
（$$グーラ$$...
　must we really fight...）

stage0044b_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$葵$$
「Even as a gift for his darling son,
　this is way too much...!」

stage0044b_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ギミー$$
「If we don't know where they'll come from,
　there's no way to prepare!」

stage0044b_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$シモン$$
「Then we crush every one that shows up!」

stage0044b_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, stay alert.
　He'll keep sending in reinforcements.」

stage0044b_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$青山$$
「Looks like that's the last of them.」

stage0044b_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$赤木$$
「All right! Now let's finish off what's left!」

stage0044b_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「My failure...!
　Bested by Earthlings, twice over!」

stage0044b_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Fall back, $$ダンカン$$.
　I'll take it from here」

stage0044b_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「...Understood.
　I'll pray for your safety」

stage0044b_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「My failure...!
　Bested by Earthlings, twice over!」

stage0044b_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「But His Highness $$グーラ$$ withdrew safely.
　I'll pull back too, then」

stage0044b_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We won, $$グーラ$$!
　Surrender quietly!」

stage0044b_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't get carried away, $$正太郎$$!
　Today's fight was just a probe!」

stage0044b_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$グーラ$$
「On the name $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$,
　I'll repay today's debt next time!」

stage0044b_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I thought we'd finally become friends,
　so why must we fight now...」

stage0044b_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I recalled Father's message.
　So you were that Mars all along」

stage0044b_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$グーラ$$
「You, who felled even Emperor $$ズール$$,
　now beg for your life at this point?」

stage0044b_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$タケル$$
「I'll say it again!
　Stop fighting, for $$正太郎$$'s sake too!」

stage0044b_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't be absurd...!
　That $$正太郎$$ wants this fight!」

stage0044b_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$ is stifling his own heart,
　trying to fight for Earth!
　Can't you see that!」

stage0044b_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「How foolish.
　Why hesitate over something like that?
　There's no need to hesitate to strike down a foe」

stage0044b_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Wake up, $$グーラ$$!
　Even now, $$正太郎$$ still thinks of you as a friend!」

stage0044b_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't you feel any hesitation, $$グーラ$$!?
　Even for a short while, you too must have
　thought of $$正太郎$$ as a friend!」

stage0044b_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$グーラ$$
「...I am $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$...
　Son of the great $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ has nothing to do with this!
　This is between you and $$正太郎$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$タケル$$
「I don't want to watch kindred hearts fight!
　Stop fighting, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Silence, Mars!
　I won't listen to your words!」

stage0044b_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$タケル$$
「Tch...!
　If it's come to this, I'll take your power to fight!」

stage0044b_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Come, robot servant of $$正太郎$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is my precious partner!
　I won't forgive you mocking him, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Then I'll destroy that $$鉄人$$!
　That'll be this $$グーラ・キング・Ｊｒ．$$'s
　first step in conquering Earth!」

stage0044b_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$...!
　If you insist on fighting,
　then I'll be your opponent!」

stage0044b_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Even for a short while, you and I were friends!
　So I'll stop you with my own hands!」

stage0044b_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Stop it, $$グーラ$$!
　Neither $$正太郎$$ nor I want to fight you!」

stage0044b_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Naive, $$ワッ太$$!
　Do you think words like that will stop me
　now that I've recalled I'm the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son!」

stage0044b_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You block-headed numbskull!
　If you want a fist that badly,
　me and Trider will give you one!」

stage0044b_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「And I'll make you apologize to $$正太郎$$ for sure!」

stage0044b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$タケル$$
「You truly won't stop fighting, $$グーラ$$!」

stage0044b_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Tiresome...!
　I've nothing more to say to you!」

stage0044b_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$タケル$$
「Then, $$グーラ$$...!
　I'll steel my heart too!」

stage0044b_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$タケル$$
「I won't let $$正太郎$$ carry this sorrow!
　I'll be the one to stop you!」

stage0044b_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$タケル$$
「Stop fighting, Prince $$グーラ$$!
　Can't you see $$正太郎$$'s grief!」

stage0044b_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$グーラ$$
「A meddlesome man.
　What are you to $$正太郎$$?」

stage0044b_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$ is my precious comrade!
　And you're that $$正太郎$$'s friend!」

stage0044b_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$タケル$$
「I know the sorrow of two kindred hearts
　forced to fight! Before that tragedy
　repeats, I'll stop you no matter what!」
